title: CoRe-SAM3: Conditional Semantic--Visual Reconciliation for SAM3 Crack Segmentation
mechanism: Keep SAM3's text-prompted ('crack') semantic map as the main decision path; train a 19k-param calibration plus a bounded, zero-initialised residual from native visual features to correct it.
adaptation: First a zero-shot SAM3 'crack' probe on our 54 val cells at 1008 input; if it detects cracks, train CoRe on crack only and fuse its logits with the house model, mainly for E1 half-cut / scuff cells.
min_experiment: Zero-shot SAM3 'crack' on val: relR@2 and relF1@2 vs house; kill if relR@2 < 0.5. Then CoRe + house logit fusion vs house PF on E1 crack relF1@2 (+0.03 needed).
evidence: R: 5 crack sets, native SAM3 62.34 -> CoRe 70.47 mean crack IoU, clDice 81.98 -> 89.24; corrects 34.4% of native errors, damages 0.23% of correct pixels; 3 seeds; RTX A2000.

alt_notes.adaptation: Only if SAM3 zero-shot 'crack' fires on EL cracks (SERD probe first); train on 478 cells crack-only at 1008 px, fuse with house for other classes.
alt_notes.min_experiment: CoRe arm vs house crack, 3 seeds; crack IoU, relF1@2, E1 relF1@2; kill if crack IoU < house.
